messages:
katie: RCA posted for the serving-degradation incident — https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1728524689
katie: TL;DR: autoscaler race + unexpected KV-cache eviction spike caused tail latency and 5xx surge during 11:30–12:10 PDT.
katie: Doc has exec summary, timeline, root cause, mitigations, and action-items table with owners + target dates. JIRA epic: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWD-1234
katie: Key actions (short):
  • Autoscaler race fix — owner: devon — target: 2024-06-07
  • Cache eviction metric + alarm (p95/p99 split) — owner: sanjay — target: 2024-05-24
  • Canary rollback/config policy + playbook note — owner: mira — target: 2024-05-21
  • CI perf regression for autoscaler path — owner: devon — target: 2024-05-30
Please ACK if you own an item or comment if dates need adjusting. 30-day checkpoint sync on 2024-06-23 (invite to follow).
devon: ack — I own the autoscaler fix. Branch autoscaler/2024-fix, PR in draft, running unit + e2e. Will request reviews EOD.
mira: ack — I'll take the canary rollback config. Quick q: any Console UI work required or just config + playbook?
katie: no UI needed initially, mira. Just config + playbook; we can open UX later if we expose controls.
sanjay: ack — I'll add eviction metric and alert. Suggest thresholds: p95 latency > 200ms AND eviction-rate > 0.02 for 3m. I'll add details in the RCA doc.
devon: adding CI perf job to run trimmed throughput tests on PRs touching autoscaler. tagging @eng-infra for runners.
opsbot: Created JIRA subtasks: RWD-1234-1 (autoscaler fix) assigned to devon, RWD-1234-2 (cache alert) assigned to sanjay, RWD-1234-3 (canary playbook) assigned to mira. Links: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWD-1234-1
katie: I'll update the action-items table with JIRA links and owners for weekly check-in. If you can't make the 30-day checkpoint, add a delegate in the doc.
mira: adding a playbook snippet and rollback checklist into the doc today.
devon: PR ready for review — requesting @sre-team and @eng-runtime review. Will merge when CI is green.
sanjay: will tune alert thresholds after one day of baseline data and post follow-up in the doc.
katie: thanks everyone — please comment if you see missing logs/traces/timelines. :thumbsup:
note: Announcement thread linking RCA, summarizing causes, listing action items, owners, and a 30-day checkpoint.
